name: Vexing Assassin (Combat)
body:
Your movements and grace give you more openings in combat.

Prerequisite(s): ability to deal precision damage

Benefit(s): Whenever you benefit from flanking you also gain a +2 bonus on melee damage rolls and on critical confirmation rolls.
